desc: Implement a function to get all coprime pairs $(u, v)$ such that $u v = A$.
Fix DP state: track `(u, v)` (reduced fraction $S_i/S_1$) and `L` (current LCM of denominators).
In DP state, track `gcd_sum`: a dictionary mapping `g` (current GCD of $s_1 \dots s_i$) to the sum of scores of paths leading to this GCD.
Sum up `gcd_sum[1]` from all final states.
